Railgun inventory: sky, air and volumes

One crop for each effect, from headless frames at dusk (day and night where noted), 2026-11-16. The bold name is the proposed name; code handles are in orange; the frame and its time are on the right.

Sky

Painted on the sky dome, 2D.

Deck

deck()idle-dusk

Small cells 5.2 km up, shrinking to the horizon. Reacts to a hit. Dev row Cloud deck. The layer we just built.

Cirrus

wisps()idle-day

Long icy streaks 9 km up, on one wind line. Reacts to a hit.

Sky

k2skyB()idle-night

Zenith, horizon, sun, moon and stars.

Cards

Camera-facing cards from cloudLayer().

Heaps

HEAPSidle-dusk

Cumulus 8 to 38 km out. The far clusters float clear of the crests.

Towers

TOWERSidle-dusk

Storm towers 105 to 150 km out, standing among the ranges.

Mids

MIDS

Per-pixel terms in every shader.

Far air, Valley fog, Far haze

farPass, uLayeridle-dusk

Air (day)

air()idle-day
